study.eventDescription: One delivered study snapshot ($5 per 1,000 rows; row keys id, title, official_title, status, last_updated, start_date, completion_date, conditions, interventions, content_hash, fetched_at). No start fee; proxy and compute included. Filters, duplicates, excluded rows and failures without delivered rows are free. Stops at maxTotalChargeUsd (Apify run option, not input). Nested data included; partial errors retain paid rows already delivered. Inspect free SUMMARY for page limits and source errors.
